name: ip-switch
description: Multi-cloud public IP rotation MCP server with Cloudflare DNS auto-update

interface.longDescription: Rotate the public IP of cloud instances across AWS / Azure / Oracle OCI / Vultr and automatically update Cloudflare DNS A records. Exposes 13 MCP tools for one-click IP rotation, instance management, and DNS sync.
defaultPrompt: Use IP Switch to rotate the public IP of a cloud instance and update its Cloudflare DNS record.
Use IP Switch to query instance info or list instances in a cloud region.
